source_quality_scale.4: official primary source or official catalogue; current legal duty, operational method, reporting contract, safety control or service definition verified
source_quality_scale.3: official source with a material live-state, dynamic-catalogue, probability, provisional, self-assessment or site-specific scope caveat

quality_guards: COMAH establishment registers and site information can change and do not provide an individual parcel accident probability.
A COMAH safety report documents controls and scenarios but does not prove current plant condition or zero residual risk.
OPSS catalogue totals and filtered counts are dynamic time-stamped snapshots.
Missing OPSS risk levels are not inferred.
Radon maps and address searches provide estimated probability, not measured building concentration.
The free radon atlas is indicative; basements, large buildings and development sites require separate treatment.
Current air-quality alerts, forecasts and latest station measurements are dynamic and provisional.
A monitoring-station result is not silently assigned to every nearby parcel.
NHS EPRR organisational ratings begin with self-assessment and are not independent proof of live incident capability.
Annual gas checks do not replace maintenance, remediation or appliance-specific assessment.
Protective-security measures depend on current threat, venue use and local vulnerability and can introduce hazards if poorly designed.
COMAH, product, radon, air, EPRR, gas and protective-security information is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
Current official-source verification does not replace 130-candidate/16-endpoint live parity, browser DOM/console acceptance, commit ancestry, publisher push or remote readback.
No second runner was started; the stale single-runner recovery blocker remains OPEN.
